title: Maison Rouge meeting

tellings.quote: So Martin Bormann assembles all the leaders of industry into this meeting in Paris, very secret meeting, they sweep the rooms to make sure no one can hear what they're going to talk about.

plain: In 1944 the Nazi official Martin Bormann is said to have gathered the leaders of German industry for a very secret meeting in Paris, known as the Maison Rouge meeting, where the rooms were swept so no one could listen in. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this, drawing on the author Peter Levenda, as part of an argument that powerful hidden networks planned to survive the war and later shaped the UFO cover-up.
